entry.name: ubutton
entry.description: Creates a transparant click-able region that can be placed over graphics or other objects. Produces a bang message when clicked.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: In "button" mode, a mouse click onhighlights it for as long as the mouse is held down, sending aout the right outlet when the mouse button is pressed down, and anotherout the left outlet when the mouse button is released. In "toggle" mode, a mouse click behaves the same as a. When the mouse is clicked,will send a 1 out the right outlet if the cursor is inside of theobject's rectangle, and 0 if it is not. It will also send these messages when the mouse button is released. When the object is in "Track Mouse While Dragging" mode, these messages are sent continuously while the mouse button is held down after a click.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Theobject can operate in one of two modes. When theis in button mode (the default mode), it responds to ain its inlet by becoming highlighted briefly and sending aout its left outlet. When ubutton is in toggle mode, ain its inlet causes it to become (and stay) highlighted and send aout its right outlet; or, if it is already highlighted, it becomes unhighlighted and sends a bang out its left outlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: Ifis waiting for a particular number (its Stay-on Value) and the incoming number matches it, the button is highlighted but nothing is sent out. If the incoming number does not match the number thatis waiting for, the button is unhighlighted (or remains that way). Ifhas a Stay-on Value of, int is the same as.

messages.name: set
messages.description: Ifis in toggle mode,sets theobject's toggle (highlights it) andclears theobject's toggle (unhighlights it). Other integer arguments forwill send the number to, for comparison to its Stay-on Value, without causing any output.
